title: Faster at the permit desks, and connected
question: Are the firms whose plan reviews finish faster than like reviews the same ones that lobby, give, or sit near a commission?
finding: Of 18 firms faster than like reviews at the permit desks, 8 also appear as a lobbyist, lobbyist client, campaign or ballot donor, commissioner's business or affiliate of a certified local firm. Most links: Clear Channel Outdoor (5): paid $4.0 million at an official's request (2020-08-27), Board decision 302 days later; people giving it as employer gave $2,550 in 9 campaign gifts to 8 committees (2012–2021); rent or guarantee to the City reduced (2021-06-25) and 2 more.
how: Firms faster than like reviews in permit_metrics (desk screen and fast-lane retest) were looked up by normalised name in the published rows of lobbyists (lobbying firms, client payments), fastlane (fast and connected), sidedoors (commissioner businesses, measure donors), chains (requested payments), officials (committees as payer), leaks (rent eased) and lbe_fronts (restricted affiliates).
limits: Speed has honest causes: complete drawings, repeat work, a large firm's in-house permit staff. Lobbying, giving and serving on a commission are permitted and reported. Campaign gifts here are by people who name the firm as employer, not by the firm. Nothing on disk ties any review to any contact; the review table does not name the reviewer. Name matches only.
